_about: Edit decisions the assembler and review page apply on top of the narration timing. in/out: where in a scene's own time its window starts and ends (seconds; defaults 0 and the scene's length). hits: moments in a scene's own time that should land on a beat; the player warps the scene's clock gently so each one does. Every cut snaps to the nearest beat within 0.35 s. dissolve (on the incoming scene): seconds of cross-dissolve centred on its cut; both scenes keep moving through it.

1.why: match cut on action: the wall is mid-tip, about 41 degrees back

2.why: the page picks up the wall's tip at the same angle; a 1.2 s dissolve melts one grid into the other mid-fall

_hits.3: the inversion; the black boxes rise on 'accident'
_hits.8: the term goes red; the fix goes mint
_hits.10: the reversal lands in the journal
_hits.11: the edit; the project goes red
_hits.12: the check passes; the chokepoint forms
